physical: Phase and phase velocity — A wave's phase advances by one cycle per wavelength; the phase velocity is wavelength times frequency, or angular frequency over wavenumber. v_p = ω ÷ k (definition)
reflected_formula: (pace of a crest) = (rate of turning) ÷ (crests per extent) — none has a frozen partner; the shape of a definition is kept
reflected_sentence: A vibration's crest advances by one full turn per wave-length, and the pace of the crest is the length of a wave times how often it turns.
rule_reason: Form: definition. No cost or separation listed. Definitions keep their shape.
interpretation: A definition keeps its shape. Nothing in it has a partner: not the turning, not the length of a wave, not how often it turns. The relation crosses as an empty definition.
conflicts: The trap 'Frequency is not a rate and not cycles per second' — this relation is exactly cycles per length and a rate; physical frequency has no partner and must not become Frequency.
closing: The rule decided on its own: definition, keeps. No judgment call on shape. The only pressure was the pun between physical frequency and TSR Frequency, which the prompt explicitly forbids; I kept frequency as 'how often it turns' in plain words. Nothing nonphysical is said.
